screen_state.body_text: As you come to a dead-end and begin to turn around, walls slam down from the ceiling, trapping you!   Three faces materialize from the walls and speak.  "Forget what you know, and I'll let you go."  "I require change to see a new space."  "If you want to pass me, then you must grow."

options.text: [Forget] Remove a card from your deck.
options.label: Forget

options.text: [Change] Transform a card in your deck.
options.label: Change

options.text: [Grow] Upgrade a card in your deck.
options.label: Grow

screen_state.body_text: Satisfied, the walls in front of you merge back into the ceiling, leaving a path forward.

You fall into a puddle.  IT'S MADE OF SLIME GOOP!!  Frantically, you claw yourself out over several minutes as you feel the goop starting to burn.  You can feel goop in your ears, goop in your nose, goop everywhere.   Climbing out, you notice that some of your gold is missing. Looking back to the puddle you see your missing coins combined with gold from unfortunate adventurers mixed together in the puddle.
Feeling the sting of the goop as the prolonged exposure starts to melt away at your skin, you manage to fish out the gold.

You walk into a room to find a large hole in the ground. As you approach the hole, an enormous serpent creature appears from within.   "Ho hooo! Hello hello! what have we got here? Hello adventurer, I ask a simple question.  The most fulfilling of lives is that in which you can buy anything!  Do you agree?"
The serpent stares at you with a look of extreme disappointment.

Navigating an unlit street, you come across several hooded figures in the midst of some dark ritual. As you approach, they turn to you in eerie unison. The tallest among them bares fanged teeth and extends a long, pale hand towards you.  "Join us brother, and feel the warmth of the Spire."

options.text: [Accept] Remove all Strikes. Receive 5 Bites. Lose 24 Max HP.
options.label: Accept

screen_state.body_text: You step back and raise your weapon in defiance. The tall figure sighs. "Very well." The entire group of hooded figures morph into a thick black fog that flows away from you.  You are alone once more.
